template <typename T> class ui::Binding  [core/Property.hpp]
    using ui::Binding< T >::element_type = typename detail::BindingSource<T>::Element
    using ui::Binding< T >::Attach = std::function<Subscription(Callback<void(T)>, T* now)>
    using ui::Binding< T >::Write = std::function<void(const T&)>
    Binding() = default
    Binding(T value)
    template <typename U> Binding(U&& value) requires (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<U>, T> && !std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<U>, Binding> && std::convertible_to<U, T>)
    template <typename A, typename B, typename... Rest> Binding(A&& a, B&& b, Rest&& ... rest) requires (!std::same_as<std::remove_cvref_t<B>, Attach>) && (std::constructible_from<T, A, B, Rest...> || (detail::OptionalValue<T>::optional && std::constructible_from<typename detail::OptionalValue<T>::type, A, B, Rest...>))
    Binding(std::initializer_list<element_type> elements) requires requires(const detail::BindingSource<T>& source) { source.collection; }
    Binding(T initial, Attach attach)
    Binding(T initial, Attach attach, Write write)
    Binding(T initial, Attach attach, Write write, const void* group) requires requires(const detail::BindingSource<T>& source) { source.group; }
    Binding(ObservableVector<element_type>* collection, typename detail::BindingSource<T>::Snapshot snapshot, Attach attach) requires requires(const detail::BindingSource<T>& source) { source.collection; }
    template <typename S> Binding(S& source) requires (detail::is_source<S> && detail::PropertyBindsTo<detail::source_value_t<S>, T>) || detail::is_collection_of<S, T>
    template <typename U> Binding(Binding<U> other) requires (!std::same_as<U, T>) && std::convertible_to<const U&, T> && (detail::binding_value_converts<U, T>())
    Binding(const Binding&) = default
    Binding& operator=(const Binding&) = default
    Binding(Binding&& other)
    Binding& operator=(Binding&& other)
    const T& initial() const
    T current() const
    bool reactive() const noexcept
    Subscription subscribe(Callback<void(T)> sink)
    bool writable() const noexcept
    Write take_writer() noexcept
    auto* observable() const noexcept requires requires(const detail::BindingSource<T>& source) { source.collection; }
    const void* selection_group() const noexcept requires requires(const detail::BindingSource<T>& source) { source.group; }

class ui::Bitmap  [render/Bitmap.hpp]
    Bitmap() = default
    Bitmap(int width, int height, const Color& fill = colors::Transparent)
    Bitmap(int width, int height, PixelFormat format)
    int width() const
    int height() const
    bool empty() const
    PixelFormat format() const
    Bitmap converted(PixelFormat format) const
    std::span<const std::uint8_t> bytes() const
    std::span<std::uint8_t> bytes()
    std::uint64_t content_id() const
    void fill(const Color& c)
    void set(int x, int y, const Color& c)
    Color get(int x, int y) const
    void blend(int x, int y, const Color& c, std::uint8_t coverage)
    std::vector<std::uint8_t> encode_png() const
    void write_png(const std::filesystem::path& path) const
    static Bitmap decode_png(const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& data)
    static Bitmap read_png(const std::filesystem::path& path)

template <typename Sig> class ui::Callback  [core/Callback.hpp]

template <typename R, typename... Args> class ui::Callback< R(Args...) const > : std::move_only_function< R(Args...) const >  [core/Callback.hpp]
    Callback() noexcept = default

template <typename R, typename... Args> class ui::Callback< R(Args...)> : std::move_only_function< R(Args...)>  [core/Callback.hpp]
    Callback() noexcept = default
    template <typename F> Callback(F&& handler) requires detail::is_outcome<R> && std::invocable<std::decay_t<F>&, Args...> && std::is_void_v<std::invoke_result_t<std::decay_t<F>&, Args...>> && std::move_constructible<std::decay_t<F>>
    template <typename F> Callback(F&& handler) requires detail::is_outcome<R> && (sizeof...(Args) > 0) && std::invocable<std::decay_t<F>&> && (!std::invocable<std::decay_t<F>&, Args...>) && std::is_void_v<std::invoke_result_t<std::decay_t<F>&>> && std::move_constructible<std::decay_t<F>>
    template <typename F> Callback(F&& handler) requires (sizeof...(Args) > 0) && std::invocable<std::decay_t<F>&> && (!std::invocable<std::decay_t<F>&, Args...>) && std::move_constructible<std::decay_t<F>> && (std::is_void_v<R> || std::convertible_to<std::invoke_result_t<std::decay_t<F>&>, R>) && (!(detail::is_outcome<R> && std::is_void_v<std::invoke_result_t<std::decay_t<F>&>>))

template <typename T> class ui::Computed  [core/Property.hpp]
    using ui::Computed< T >::value_type = T
    template <typename Fn, typename... Ss> Computed(Fn fn, const Ss& ... sources) requires (sizeof...(Ss) > 0) && (detail::is_source<Ss> && ...) && std::invocable<Fn&, const detail::source_value_t<Ss>&...> && std::convertible_to<std::invoke_result_t<Fn&, const detail::source_value_t<Ss>&...>, T> && (std::copy_constructible<detail::source_value_t<Ss>> && ...)
    Computed(const Computed&) = delete
    Computed& operator=(const Computed&) = delete
    const T& get() const noexcept
    const T& operator*() const noexcept
    const T* operator->() const noexcept
    Subscription observe(Callback<void(const T&)> fn) const
    const Property<T>& property() const noexcept

template <typename T> class ui::ObservableVector : ui::PropertyBase  [core/ObservableVector.hpp]
    using ui::ObservableVector< T >::value_type = T
    using ui::ObservableVector< T >::iterator = Iterator<false>
    using ui::ObservableVector< T >::const_iterator = Iterator<true>
    ObservableVector() = default
    ObservableVector(std::initializer_list<T> items) requires std::copy_constructible<T>
    ~ObservableVector()
    std::size_t size() const noexcept
    bool empty() const noexcept
    const Property<std::size_t>& count() const noexcept
    T& operator[](std::size_t index)
    const T& operator[](std::size_t index) const
    T& front()
    const T& front() const
    T& back()
    const T& back() const
    std::optional<std::size_t> index_of(const T& item) const
    iterator begin() noexcept
    iterator end() noexcept
    const_iterator begin() const noexcept
    const_iterator end() const noexcept
    T& push_back(T item, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::move_constructible<T>
    template <typename... Args> T& emplace_back(Args&& ... args) requires std::constructible_from<T, Args...>
    T& insert(std::size_t index, T item, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::move_constructible<T>
    template <typename... Args> T& emplace(std::size_t index, Args&& ... args) requires std::constructible_from<T, Args...>
    void erase(std::size_t index, std::size_t count = 1, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current())
    bool remove(const T& item, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current())
    template <typename Predicate> std::size_t erase_if(Predicate predicate, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::predicate<Predicate&, const T&>
    T& replace(std::size_t index, T item, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::move_constructible<T>
    void move(std::size_t from, std::size_t to, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current())
    void clear(std::source_location where = std::source_location::current())
    template <typename Range> void assign(const Range& items, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires requires(const Range& range) { { *std::begin(range) } -> std::convertible_to<T>; }
    void assign(std::initializer_list<T> items, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::copy_constructible<T>
    template <typename Edits> void batch(Edits edits, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::invocable<Edits&>
    Subscription observe(Callback<void(const CollectionChange&)> fn) const

template <typename T> class ui::Property : ui::PropertyBase  [core/Property.hpp]
    using ui::Property< T >::value_type = T
    Property() = default
    Property(T value)
    const T& get() const noexcept
    const T& operator*() const noexcept
    const T* operator->() const noexcept
    void set(T value, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current())
    Property& operator=(detail::AssignedValue<T> value)
    Property& operator+=(detail::AssignedValue<T> delta) requires (!std::same_as<T, bool>) && requires(const T& a, const T& b) { { a + b } -> std::convertible_to<T>; }
    Property& operator-=(detail::AssignedValue<T> delta) requires (!std::same_as<T, bool>) && requires(const T& a, const T& b) { { a - b } -> std::convertible_to<T>; }
    Property& operator++() requires requires(T& t) { ++t; }
    Property& operator--() requires requires(T& t) { --t; }
    T operator++(int) requires requires(T& t) { ++t; }
    T operator--(int) requires requires(T& t) { --t; }
    void toggle(std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::same_as<T, bool>
    template <typename Fn> void update(Fn&& fn, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) requires std::invocable<Fn&, T&>
    Subscription observe(Callback<void(const T&)> fn) const

class ui::PropertyBase  [core/Property.hpp]
    PropertyBase(const PropertyBase&) = delete
    PropertyBase& operator=(const PropertyBase&) = delete
    std::size_t observer_count() const noexcept
    protected PropertyBase() = default
    protected ~PropertyBase()
    protected Subscription attach(Callback<void(const void*)> fn, std::source_location where = std::source_location::current()) const
    protected void dispatch(const void* value)
    protected void check_write(std::string_view call, const std::source_location& where) const

class ui::TableViewControl : ui::Element, ui::SelectionProvider, ui::GridProvider, ui::TableProvider  [ui/collections/TableView.hpp]
    using ui::TableViewControl::SortComparer = Callback<std::weak_ordering(std::size_t column, std::size_t row_a, std::size_t row_b)>
    TableViewControl()
    ~TableViewControl() override
    TableViewControl(const TableViewControl&) = delete
    TableViewControl& operator=(const TableViewControl&) = delete
    TableViewControl(TableViewControl&&) = delete
    TableViewControl& operator=(TableViewControl&&) = delete

    const std::vector<std::vector<std::string>>& rows() const
    void set_rows(std::vector<std::vector<std::string>> rows)

    void set_row_height(float height)
    bool size_rows_to_content() const
    void set_size_rows_to_content(bool on)
    float column_actual_width(std::size_t column) const
    void set_column_width(std::size_t column, TableViewColumnWidth width)
    void set_column_frozen(std::size_t column, bool frozen)
    void set_column_frozen_trailing(std::size_t column, bool frozen)
    bool can_user_resize_columns() const
    void set_can_user_resize_columns(bool can)

    float horizontal_offset() const
    void set_horizontal_offset(float offset)
    bool can_user_sort_columns() const
    void set_can_user_sort_columns(bool can)
    std::optional<std::size_t> sort_column() const
    TableViewSortDirection sort_direction() const
    bool sort_by_column(std::size_t column, TableViewSortDirection direction)
    bool toggle_sort_direction(std::size_t column)
    std::optional<std::size_t> header_cursor() const
    bool clear_sort()
    void set_sort_comparer(SortComparer comparer)
    void on_sorting(Callback<Decision(const TableViewSortingArgs&)> handler)
    void on_sorted(Callback<void(const TableViewSortedArgs&)> handler)
    static std::weak_ordering compare_text(const std::string& a, const std::string& b)
    std::optional<std::size_t> row_at_position(std::size_t position) const
    std::optional<std::size_t> position_of_row(std::size_t row) const
    std::size_t position_count() const
    SelectionMode selection_mode() const
    void set_selection_mode(SelectionMode mode)
    std::optional<std::size_t> selected_row() const
    void set_selected_row(std::optional<std::size_t> index)

template <typename T> class ui::TwoWayBinding : ui::Binding< T >  [core/Property.hpp]

template <typename T> class ui::TwoWayField : ui::Binding< T >  [core/Property.hpp]
    TwoWayField() = default
    TwoWayField(Binding<T> binding)
    TwoWayField(ChoiceBinding choice) requires std::same_as<T, std::size_t>
    template <typename U> TwoWayField(const TwoWayBinding<U>& two_way) requires detail::LossyWriteBack<U, T> && (!detail::UnsetIntoPlain<U, T>)
    template <typename S> TwoWayField(S& source) requires detail::is_source<S> && (!std::is_const_v<S>) && std::same_as<S, Property<detail::source_value_t<S>>> && detail::LossyWriteBack<detail::source_value_t<S>, T> && (!detail::UnsetIntoPlain<detail::source_value_t<S>, T>)
    template <typename U> TwoWayField(const TwoWayBinding<U>& two_way) = delete requires detail::OptionalValue<T>::optional && (!detail::OptionalValue<U>::optional)
    template <typename S> TwoWayField(S& source) = delete requires detail::is_source<S> && detail::PropertyBindsTo<detail::source_value_t<S>, T> && (!std::is_const_v<S>) && std::same_as<S, Property<detail::source_value_t<S>>> && detail::OptionalValue<T>::optional && (!detail::OptionalValue<detail::source_value_t<S>>::optional)
